response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior/staff-level engineer with ~15 years of shipping production software, solid TypeScript/Node.js depth, distributed low-latency systems, DevOps, and a genuine track record of teaching and mentoring — all valuable for a customer-facing Staff FDE. However, the role's core requirement of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions is not met: relevant AI exposure appears limited to roughly the last year at re:cinq (MCP code generators, agentic tooling). The resume shows no Python, no vector databases or RAG architectures, no LLM evaluation/observability work, and only light cloud footprint (AWS CDK). Worth a screening call if the team values engineering excellence and MCP/agent-tooling familiarity over deep GenAI tenure, but he is a clear stretch against the stated bar.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems across web, backend, mobile, and embedded
Hands-on MCP and agentic workflow tooling experience at re:cinq
Strong mentoring, workshops, and technical-leadership/consulting background
concerns: Roughly 1 year of AI-related work vs. the 8+ year requirement
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks
Python absent from skills; limited cloud-scale AI architecture experience

key_factors.factor: Senior full-stack engineering and leadership breadth
Missing RAG/vector DB/Python and cloud AI stack
